qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for vacuum pump mounting bolts on the cylinder head for all engine types?
What screw size and torque is used for M51/M41 engine vacuum pump mounting?
What is the torque specification for microencapsulated vacuum pump bolts on M51/M41 engines?
Which engine codes use M8 screws for vacuum pump mounting?
What is the difference in screw size between standard vacuum pump mounting and microencapsulated mounting on M51/M41 engines?
qa_pairs.answer: Standard uses M8 screws while microencapsulated uses M9 screws, both with the same 22 Nm torque.

qa_pairs.question: What component is covered in section 11 66 of the manual?
What is the specific part designation 1AZ referring to in this torque specification table?
Are the torque values the same for M51/M41 engines regardless of whether the bolts are microencapsulated or not?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both standard and microencapsulated bolts on M51/M41 engines require 22 Nm torque.

qa_pairs.question: What is the lowest torque specification shown for vacuum pump mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: 10 Nm for M6 screws on all engine types.

qa_pairs.question: Which screw size requires the highest torque for vacuum pump installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Both M8 and M9 screws require the highest torque at 22 Nm.
